description.value: Grill & Vine is a Pacific Northwest-inspired restaurant inside the Westin Resort and Spa in Whistler, where Executive Chef Elliot Brass builds menus around regional, fresh, and sustainable BC ingredients — including locally sourced salmon on a mountain-view summer patio. The restaurant also runs a Grab & Go counter stocked with fresh-baked goods, sandwiches, coffee, and snacks, making it a practical stop for cyclists who need a quick resupply rather than a sit-down meal. The attached FireRock Lounge rounds out the offering for an end-of-day wind-down.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 87m; rack at 89m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Grill & Vine is an active, full-service restaurant inside the Westin Resort and Spa in Whistler, with a Grab & Go counter explicitly described as offering sandwiches, coffee, and refreshments. Contact details (address and phone) were sourced entirely from the website since OSM contained no address or phone. No bike-specific amenities, Wi-Fi, or device charging are mentioned anywhere on the site; the dietary claim ('encompasses all lifestyles and dietary preferences') is too vague to confirm specific vegetarian/vegan/GF options.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone number; both sourced from website only — contact_confirmed fields for phone and address are null.
No bike parking information found anywhere on the website; a site visit is recommended to confirm whether racks exist on the Westin Resort property.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established restaurant in the heart of Whistler with a Grab & Go counter that is directly useful to touring cyclists needing a quick resupply; bike parking status should be verified on a site visit.
enrichment_extras.notes: Phone number (604) 935-4344 appears on the /events subpage. Restaurant is operated by the Westin Resort and Spa, Whistler (Marriott property); email contact is wrs.restaurant@westinwhistler.com.
